issue_request: FHIR-17188 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ImplementationGuide change request asking to add the MetadataResource title element to the ImplementationGuide resource for STU3.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN revision 14539. Imported git-svn commit 77430e3b746d4a204fdaf5caf6105a75eafea871, build@14539, has subject "GF#17188 - add Ig.title" and added an ImplementationGuide.title row to the old implementationguide-spreadsheet.xml source. The 2021 source rework retained the element in structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists implementationguide=ImplementationGuide, so the resource source is in current build scope. The resource now uses the CanonicalResource pattern rather than the older MetadataResource wording, but it explicitly defines ImplementationGuide.title as a 0..1 string summary element, and the current search-parameter source exposes a title parameter. Confluence minutes corroborate the 2018-08-06 Persuasive vote; community searches found no contradictory later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already satisfies the request.
